content: When KAT makes a great play at the Garden, the announcer could say his name like they used to say Carmelllllllooooo Anthonnnnnnny, only like this: Karrrrrllllll Anthonnnnnnny. Everyone would shriek then laugh and feel nostalgic, knowing KAT is the real thing and Melo was a star but not the star. And what would be really cool if the fans in the Garden would answer it with TOWNS!
